ops.title: Teammate subagents are foreground-only — sweeps inside a team must delegate to a Workflow
ops.body:
Hit live in the v14 test-suite-reconstruction team (2026-07-14): the 1h43m p3-tests teammate planned a 4-way background fan-out for module conversions, but an in-process teammate's own subagents run in the foreground — `run_in_background: true` returns an error (documented: code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-teams#limitations). It degraded to batched synchronous spawns and spent ~33% of its wall-clock (522s/433s single waits) blocked on 11 nested opus agents.

**Why:** teams are sized for a handful of long-running peers with agent-to-agent handoffs; workflows are the surface for dozens-to-hundreds of agents per run (docs/en/workflows#when-to-use-a-workflow).

**How to apply:** a teammate holding a bounded N-unit sweep (test-module conversions, per-file migrations, mechanical refactors) delegates it to a `Workflow` fan-out instead of nesting `Agent` calls. Codified fleet-wide in CLAUDE.md § Plan Execution & Orchestration ("Sweeps are workflows, not teams", Models table v5, 2026-07-14). Nested spawns also follow the Models table: bounded decision-light conversion units route to gpt-5.6-sol via codex-wrapper, not to opus by default.
